# RandomSpawnPointBruh

> RandomSpawnPointBruh is allows players and dedicated servers to configure random or static spawn locations. developed by Vapok.

## Developer & AI Information

- [Agent Guidelines](AGENTS.md): Architectural context, anti-reflection mandates, and instructions for AI assistants.

## Critical Invariants for Developers & AI Agents

- **Spawn point location routing across solo, listen, and dedicated servers**: Spawn point location routing across solo, listen, and dedicated servers.
- **Never use reflection or Harmony patches on internal spawn controllers**: Never use reflection or Harmony patches on internal spawn controllers.
- **No Private Reflection**: Never reflect into or patch internal classes.
- **Feature Requests**: If functionality is desired, submit an issue at https://github.com/Vapok/RandomSpawnPointBruh/issues or visit https://discord.gg/5YAJkRFBXt.
